# Yash's Tech, AI & Quantitative Research Blog

## Sovereign AI & High-Throughput Inference
- [High-Throughput Local LLM Serving with vLLM PagedAttention](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/high-throughput-local-llm-serving-with-vllm-pagedattention-and-continuous-batching/): Continuous batching, GPU kernel optimization, and benchmark throughput.
- [Deploying Sovereign AI Agents with MCP and Local LLMs](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/deploying-sovereign-ai-agents-with-local-llms-and-model-context-protocol-mcp/): Air-gapped agentic orchestration and secure tool execution.
- [Implementing Hybrid Semantic RAG with Qdrant Vector Search](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/implementing-hybrid-semantic-rag-with-qdrant-vector-search-and-bm25-reranking/): Reciprocal rank fusion and dense embedding retrieval.
- [Fine-Tuning Llama 3 and Qwen Models with Unsloth and QLoRA](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/fine-tuning-llama-3-and-qwen-models-with-unsloth-and-qlora-on-consumer-gpus/): 4-bit quantization, gradient checkpointing, and parameter-efficient tuning.

## Quantitative Finance & Algorithmic Trading
- [Real-Time Stock Market Data Ingestion via WebSockets and Order Book Microstructure](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/real-time-stock-market-data-ingestion-via-websockets-and-order-book-microstructure/): L2/L3 order book reconstruction, market depth, and microsecond latency pipelines.
- [Options Greeks Modeling and Volatility Surface Calibration with Black-Scholes](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/options-greeks-modeling-and-volatility-surface-calibration-with-black-scholes/): Implied volatility smile, Delta/Gamma hedging, and numerical root-finding.
- [Statistical Arbitrage and Pairs Trading with Cointegration and Kalman Filters](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/statistical-arbitrage-and-pairs-trading-with-cointegration-and-kalman-filters/): Engle-Granger two-step test, dynamic hedge ratios, and mean-reversion execution.
- [Portfolio Optimization with Modern Portfolio Theory and Markowitz Efficient Frontier](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/portfolio-optimization-with-modern-portfolio-theory-and-markowitz-efficient-frontier-in-python/): Quadratic programming, Sharpe maximization, and covariance shrinkage.

## Commodities, Metals & Energy Markets
- [Gold & Silver Sovereign Macro Arbitrage: Real Yields and Central Bank Flows](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/gold-and-silver-sovereign-macro-arbitrage-real-yields-central-bank-reserve-shifts-and-volatility-hedging/): 10-Year TIPS inverse correlation, liquidity regime shifts, and sovereign reserve shifts.
- [Crude Oil Market Microstructure: Brent vs WTI Spreads and OPEC+ Quotas](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/crude-oil-market-microstructure-analyzing-brent-vs-wti-spreads-opec-quotas-and-refinery-crack-margins/): Cushing physical storage, tanker logistics, and OPEC+ supply constraints.
- [Copper & Critical Minerals: Physical Supply Bottlenecks Behind AI Datacenters](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/copper-and-critical-minerals-physical-supply-bottlenecks-behind-ai-datacenter-electrification/): Grid electrification demand, smelter fee dynamics, and supply elasticity.
- [Quantitative Energy Trading: Backtesting 3-2-1 Crack Spread Arbitrage](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/quantitative-energy-trading-backtesting-3-2-1-crack-spread-arbitrage-and-mean-reversion-in-python/): Refinery crack spread modeling and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reversion.

## Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Hardening
- [Configuring ZFS Storage Pool for High Availability](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/configuring-zfs-storage-pool-for-high-availability-in-home-servers/): Redundant pool layout, scrubbing, and automated snapshots.
- [Automating Kubernetes Cluster Deployment with Ansible](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/automating-kubernetes-cluster-deployment-with-ansible/): Bare-metal control planes, CNI plugins, and worker join workflows.
- [Proxmox VE High Availability Cluster Architecture](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/proxmox-ve-high-availability-home-lab-setup/): Quorum configuration, Ceph distributed storage, and failover fencing.
- [Hardening Docker Containers for Self-Hosted Applications](https://blog.yashkumarnavadiya.tech/blog/hardening-docker-containers-for-self-hosted-applications/): Seccomp, AppArmor, non-root user namespaces, and read-only mounts.
